She claims that her husband drugged her and made her unconscious. Then he took nude photos and videos. After that, he started threatening to make them viral. The husband blackmailed her and took 32.50 lakh rupees to buy a Fortuner and 10 lakh rupees from an FD. Then he remarried without divorcing her. When she protested, he tried to kill her. The wife stated that her husband is an unconsciousness doctor (anesthesiologist). He has relationships with several girls. The woman filed a case against her husband, in-laws, and sister-in-law at 9 PM on Monday. The case is from the Shahpur police station area. Spent 50 lakh on wedding, then started demanding Fortuner car A 35-year-old female doctor residing in the Shahpur area is currently posted in Basti. Her father is an engineer. On Tuesday, she filed a case against her husband, in-laws, and sister-in-law for attempted murder, marrying a second time without divorce, assault, and dowry harassment. In the complaint given to the police, she stated, On November 29, 2019, I was married to a doctor residing in Nabhpur, Chhattisgarh. On November 30, I left for my in-laws' house. I am the only child in the family. Therefore, my father spent 50 lakh rupees on my wedding. Despite this, from the very first day at her in-laws' house, she was taunted that even after being the only daughter of an engineer father, they couldn't provide a Fortuner car. Later, her husband also started pressuring her to ask for money to buy a Fortuner. When she refused, along with her husband, her mother-in-law, father-in-law, and sister-in-law also started harassing her. They would drug her, make her unconscious, then make nude videos The woman doctor stated that her husband would drug her by mixing intoxicants in cold drinks and make her unconscious. After that, he would make her nude and record videos. Then he started blackmailing her by showing the videos. He would say that if she didn't arrange the money, he would viral the videos on social media, and she wouldn't be able to show her face anywhere. I told this to my parents. To save the marriage, they arranged money and gave 32.50 lakh rupees to my in-laws on March 28, 2022, to buy a Fortuner. After this, on April 14, 2022, I had a son. Still, my husband's habits did not change. I had an FD of 20 lakh rupees in the Indian Post Office, Alinagar, Gorakhpur. My husband broke it and took 10 lakh rupees. Husband and wife got separate transfers The woman doctor said - Meanwhile, my husband was posted at Balrampur Hospital in Lucknow. But, he used to live in Basti. Whereas, I was posted at Fatehpur Hospital. For a few days, we both worked at different places. After this, I was posted at a hospital in Basti. Upon arriving here, I found out that my husband had been involved with several women. When I asked my husband about this, he started beating me. He repeatedly threatened to divorce me. Meanwhile, on November 26, 2024, I gave birth to a daughter. During this time, I went to my in-laws' house. Husband said - I will keep two wives together The female doctor stated - my husband started keeping a female doctor who works in the anesthesia department with him. He also started bringing her home. When I protested, my husband and in-laws brutally beat me. The in-laws got my husband married to that other female doctor. My husband says that he will keep both wives together. Everyone will earn together. On February 13, 2025, they both went on their honeymoon, taking a flight from Chhattisgarh Airport to Pune (Maharashtra). They stayed there for 4 days. Tied with a rope and hung The female doctor said- My husband remarried without divorcing me. I continuously opposed this. Meanwhile, on May 7, 2026, my husband along with my in-laws beat me up, tied a rope around my neck, and hung me from the fan. However, my life was saved because the rope broke. After this, I was beaten up along with my two children and thrown out of the house. My in-laws came to my house in Shahpur on July 12, 2026, to get a divorce. They wanted to take my son. The father-in-law said that my son has remarried. Sign the divorce papers. I refused, citing the children. At this, my husband along with my father-in-law attacked me, in which I was injured. Shahpur Police Station in-charge Jitendra Kumar Singh said that a case has been registered under serious sections on the complaint of the woman doctor. Strict action will be taken based on investigation and evidence.

stories.title: Champat Rai visits Ayodhya two month after donation theft case:Says he will spend the rest of his life here; holds closed-door meeting with Paramhans Acharya
stories.summary: Champat Rai was seen in Ayodhya on Tuesday, nearly two months after the theft of offerings from the Ram Mandir. He reached the Tapasvi Chhawani Mandir, where Mahant Paramhans Acharya welcomed him by applying a tilak. The two also had a closed-door conversation. Speaking to the media, Paramhans Acharya praised Champat Rai's work, stating that the grand Ram Mandir was built under his leadership. The saint community wishes that Champat Rai remains in Ayodhya for life. The case of theft of offerings from the Ram Mandir came to light in June 2026. Following this, the UP government formed an SIT and started an investigation. An FIR was registered based on the SIT's interim report. So far, eight accused have been arrested. After the incident, Champat Rai had resigned from the post of General Secretary of the Trust. He had stated that he would elaborate on the matter only after the investigation was complete. See 3 pictures Champat Rai called the allegations against him baseless Champat Rai had resigned from the post of General Secretary of Shri Ram Janmabhoomi Teerth Kshetra Trust on June 26, 2026. A meeting of the Trust was held at the Ram Mandir on July 6. Champat Rai's resignation was accepted in this. In place of Champat Rai, new trustee retired IFS Krishna Mohan was made the acting General Secretary. After the meeting, Treasurer Govind Dev Giri had said, Champat Rai has said that it is not right to remain in office until the culprits are caught. What happened is painful. We are all saddened by this. The theft of offerings is a shameful incident. The next day, on July 7, he wrote a letter to Ram devotees on social media platform X, calling the allegations against him baseless. He had said that he would elaborate on the matter only after the SIT investigation was complete.

stories.title: Son-in-law's eyes gouged out, throat slit private parts mutilated:Couple had love marriage 3 years ago; woman's grandparents and uncle-aunt arrested
stories.summary: In Amethi, a man is allegedly killed by his wife's family, who oppose their love marriage. Police say the accused slit his throat, gouged out his eyes, and mutilated his body after dragging him inside their house when he returned from the market. Hearing his screams, the victim's family alerts police after no one opens the door. By the time officers arrive, the accused have fled, and the body is found inside a room. Enraged locals block the road late at night, prompting heavy police deployment. A case is registered against the woman's uncle, aunt, grandmother, and grandfather. Three are arrested, while the uncle is later apprehended after police shoot him in the leg during an encounter. The incident takes place on Monday night in the Gauriganj Kotwali area, and the body is sent for post-mortem after the protest ends. 3 pictures Know the complete case Kallu Kashyap, a resident of Ward No. 17 of Pure Man Singh, had a son, Ankit Kashyap (22), in his family, besides his wife. Housla Yadav's house is about 50 meters away from Kallu's house. Housla's only daughter Shweta, had an affair with Ankit. About 3 years ago, Ankit eloped with Shweta and had a love marriage. After this, Shweta's family members had filed a case of kidnapping of their daughter. Later, the police recovered Shweta and Ankit. Shweta was an adult. She insisted on living with her husband, Ankit. After this, both left home and started living in Delhi. In Delhi, Ankit used to do a private job. He lived there in a rented room. Ankit and Shweta have 2 sons. The elder son is 2 years old, and the younger one is one year old. Ankit returned from Delhi on July 31 It is said that on Friday (July 31), Ankit had come to Amethi to meet his family, leaving his wife Shweta and both children in Delhi. On Monday night, he was supposed to return to Delhi. For this, he went to the market in the evening to buy some items. Around 8:30 PM, when Ankit returned from the market, Shweta's uncle Sukai, aunt Sarita, grandfather Ram Sundar (60), and grandmother Ranjana surrounded and caught him. They dragged him to their house. They locked him in a room and severely beat him with kicks and punches. Then they gouged out his eyes. After that, they cut off his private part. Then they slit his throat. Hearing Ankit's screams, his family members reached the spot, and Shweta's family members fled through the back door. The family members first took Ankit, who was lying covered in blood, to the district hospital in a serious condition. However, seeing Ankit's critical condition, he was referred to Lucknow. Ankit succumbed to his injuries on the way while being brought to Lucknow. Highway blocked at 11 PM As soon as the news of Ankit's death was received, a large number of people gathered at the district hospital around 11:30 PM. People first created a ruckus at the hospital. After this, they blocked the Sultanpur Highway. Seeing the commotion escalate, forces from 7 police stations reached the spot. SP Saravanan T also reached the scene late at night. He pacified Ankit's family members. Only then did the people calm down and the blockade was cleared. SP Saravanan T stated- Last night, a young man was murdered. Its main accused, Sukai Yadav, had absconded. Today, during an encounter in the Tikariya forest, he was shot in the leg. He has been admitted to CHC. Sukhari already has cases registered against him under robbery, theft, and Arms Act. In this case, Sukai's wife Sarita, Sukai's mother Ranjana, and father Ram Sundar were arrested last night.

stories.title: Overbridge stuck for 1.5 years finally ready:Brings relief to 3 lakh Lucknow residents; locals say patients won't die in ambulances now
stories.summary: The overbridge in Kesari Kheda, Lucknow, which was suspended in the air for one and a half years, is now complete. This flyover, built at the railway crossing, will soon open for the general public. However, people have already started using it. The construction of this overbridge began on 17 July 2023, but due to a complex coming in its way, work remained stalled from June 2024 to June 2025. After that, the complex was demolished, and work resumed. Now, most of the flyover's work has been completed. Approximately ₹84 crore have been spent on the construction of this 974-metre long overbridge. Currently, finishing touches are being given before the inauguration of the overbridge. Work on installing streetlights on both sides and painting is underway. The people of the area are eagerly awaiting the opening of the flyover. People say that its opening will provide great relief from traffic jams at the railway crossing. Earlier, ambulances often used to get stuck in jams here. Many times, patients even died. Work had stopped due to the complex coming in the middle of the bridge During the construction of the overbridge, a four-storey complex came in the middle. Due to this, the construction work of the bridge had to be stopped. The work remained closed for about a year. During this period, more than 3 lakh people living within a 3-kilometre radius had to face daily traffic jams. Meanwhile, the business of local traders was also severely affected. 3 lakh people of the area will get relief Local resident Dilip Kumar Srivastava said that this flyover will become a source of relief for 3 lakh people. Since the construction began, there has been a lot of trouble with commuting for the past 3 years. After school, children struggle with traffic jams for hours. Seeing this, they are now breathing a sigh of relief. “A very big work has been done in this area. We are very happy. With the bridge opening, people from dozens of colonies including Kesari Kheda, Manas Nagar, Vijay Nagar, Chunnu Kheda, Prasadi Kheda, Pandit Kheda, Shubham City, Gokul State, Balkrishna Nagar will get relief,” Dilip said. The bridge has reduced the distance by 6 kilometres David Rawat, a resident of Hanskheda, said that the bridge construction will bring great relief. Four-wheelers cause traffic jams at the crossing. Due to the bad road, two-wheelers often met with accidents. Due to the absence of a flyover, one has to travel 6 kilometers extra to commute. He has a 70-year-old mother who is undergoing treatment at Lokbandhu Hospital. Once the bridge opens, the biggest relief will be in taking his mother to the hospital. Traders said will distribute laddoos on the inauguration day Local businessman Deepu Yadav said that there is a traffic jam here for two to three hours daily. This causes problems for school students and they are unable to reach their work on time. Ambulances also face a lot of difficulty in getting through due to the jam. Many times, patients could not be taken to the hospital on time and they died in the ambulance itself. Deepu said that his cement-sand shop is located here, but due to traffic jams and construction work, business was severely affected. “Now the flyover is ready. We are just waiting for its inauguration. On the day the flyover starts, traders will distribute ladoos in happiness,” he said. He said that when the construction work of the flyover was stalled, there was a lot of disappointment. Now, after the completion of construction, there is happiness. It is hoped that people and traders will get relief from the daily traffic jams.

The approximately 5-kilometer long procession will start from Nazim Sahab Imambara in Chowk and proceed to Karbala in Talkatora. Thousands of people from the Shia community are participating in the procession, dressed in black clothes and barefoot. Outside Imambara Nazim Sahab, pictures of Donald Trump and Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, along with the flags of America and Israel, have been placed on the ground. People are trampling on them with their feet as they move forward. At the forefront of the procession, devotees are carrying the approximately 25-foot-high Alam-e-Mubarak of Hazrat Abbas. Many people have also joined the procession carrying pictures of Iran's former Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei and his son Mojtaba Khamenei. During the procession, a large number of devotees performed matam (self-flagellation) with chains. Marks of injury were visible on the bodies of many devotees due to matam. They appeared to be bleeding. Strict security arrangements have also been made for the procession. During this, a small girl distributed Melody toffees to the people. stories.summary: The Uttar Pradesh government ordered the transfer of 13 senior IAS officers on Tuesday, including the Divisional Commissioners of Gorakhpur, Basti, Bareilly, and Prayagraj. The administration released the transfer list at approximately 3:15 pm. Saumya Agarwal, who served as Prayagraj's first female Divisional Commissioner, has been reassigned to the post of State Labour Commissioner. Agarwal is married to IPS officer Mohit Gupta. Her tenure drew widespread attention following a controversy involving Shankaracharya Avimukteshwaranand at the Prayagraj Magh Mela on 18 January 2026. The reassignment follows the recent transfer of Inspector General Mohit Gupta to the Anti-Corruption Organisation. Dr Lokesh M. has been appointed as the new Divisional Commissioner of Prayagraj, succeeding Saumya Agarwal. See the profiles of four senior officers 1. Saumya Agarwal completed her schooling up to intermediate level in Lucknow. After obtaining an engineering degree from Delhi University, she worked for a software company in Pune. She subsequently shifted her focus towards the Civil Services, securing 24th rank in the Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) examination on her very first attempt. Her father, Gyan Chand Agarwal, served as a civil engineer in the Indian Railways. 2. Anil Dhingra has been removed from the post of Gorakhpur Divisional Commissioner and appointed Commissioner of the UP Housing and Development Board. Additionally, he has been entrusted with the responsibilities of Director of Urban Land Ceiling and Secretary to the Housing and Urban Planning Department. A 2008-batch IAS officer, Dhingra originally hails from Delhi. Before joining the Civil Services, he qualified as a Chartered Accountant and completed an MBA at Delhi University. His initial posting was as Joint Magistrate in Farrukhabad, after which he served as Chief Development Officer (CDO) in Rampur. He later served as District Magistrate in Rampur as well. 3. Indra Vikram Singh, who was serving as Secretary to the Agriculture Department, has been appointed as the new Divisional Commissioner of Gorakhpur. Simultaneously, Principal Secretary for Agriculture Ravindra has been given the additional charge of Director of the State Agricultural Produce Markets Board alongside his current responsibilities. Originally hailing from Fatehpur, Indra Vikram Singh began his career as a Provincial Civil Service (PCS) officer. His first posting came in 2011 as Secretary to the Aligarh Development Authority. He was promoted to the IAS in 2016 and has previously served as District Magistrate in both Ballia and Shamli. 4. Bareilly Divisional Commissioner Bhupendra S. Chaudhary has been transferred to the position of Secretary to the Administrative Reforms Department. Shambhu Kumar, who served as Managing Director of Purvanchal Vidyut Vitran Nigam Limited, has been appointed as the new Divisional Commissioner of Bareilly. A 2009-batch Indian Administrative Service officer of the UP cadre, Chaudhary holds a BSc in Botany. Over the course of his administrative career, he has served in various capacities, including Secretary, Special Secretary to the State Government, District Collector, and Director. stories.title: Couple and woman found murdered in Prayagraj:All three were deaf and mute; blood-soaked bodies found on one bed
stories.summary: A sensational triple murder came to light in Prayagraj on Tuesday, where a man, his wife, and another woman were brutally killed inside a single room. The blood-soaked bodies of all three victims — who were speech and hearing-impaired — were discovered lying on the bed. The gruesome incident was uncovered in the morning when neighbours noticed the room door half-open and peered inside. The horrifying sight caused panic, and the police were alerted immediately. A team of police officers alongside forensic experts rushed to the scene to collect evidence before sending the bodies for post-mortem examinations. Authorities have detained the landlady’s son for questioning. The crime took place in the Garhi Kala neighbourhood under the jurisdiction of the Shahganj police station in the Old City area. Photos from the scene Landlady States: Husband and Wife Were Speech and Hearing-Impaired Sushila Devi owns the three-storey house in the Garhi Kala neighbourhood, where she resides on the ground floor with her son Pankaj (30). Pankaj works as an auto-rickshaw driver following his father's death. The deceased couple lived on the first floor, while three young men—Atul Singh, Dhananjay Singh, and Rishi Singh—reside on the second floor, earning their living as itinerant food vendors at the railway station. According to the landlady, the couple had been renting the premises for the past six months and made a living collecting scrap metal, which they sold to Shyamlal, a local scrap dealer. Because the husband and wife were deaf-mute, no one in the locality knew them by name. She added that an unknown woman had come to visit them on Monday. "I had never seen her before," Sushila Devi stated. "Assuming she was a relative, I did not question her. I went to bed at around midnight. When I came outside on Tuesday morning, I noticed their room door was open and asked neighbours to check on them. It was only when the neighbours looked inside that the murders were discovered." Tenant says loud noises were heard at night Rishi Singh, a native of Hardoi who lives as a tenant on the second floor, stated that he has been residing in the building for the past eight months. He recalled hearing the sound of a heavy object falling during the night, which he initially assumed was someone dropping a gas cylinder. However, being drowsy, he paid it no further mind. It was only upon waking in the morning that he learned three people had been murdered in the room below. Scrap merchant knew the deceased couple for 20 Years Local scrap dealer Shyamlal stated that he had known the deceased couple for two decades. According to him, the pair originally claimed to be from Kolkata. While they initially lived on the pavement, they later moved into rented accommodation. They had previously rented a room in the same building about two and a half years ago before relocating elsewhere, only to return six months ago. Shyamlal added that the couple had no known enmities with anyone. He identified the third victim as an acquaintance who occasionally accompanied the couple to sell scrap. He noted that the woman, whose husband had died, struggled with severe alcohol addiction and had visited his shop in an intoxicated state only yesterday. Deputy Commissioner of Police (City) Manish Shandilya stated: "The bodies of two women and one man were recovered from a rented room. All three were speech and hearing-impaired. It is suspected that a deadly brawl broke out among them. Efforts are currently underway to formally identify the deceased."

stories.title: Pregnant wife drinks acid after husband's suicide:Admitted to ICU in Kanpur, couple had love marriage in Delhi two years ago
stories.summary: A young man from Hamirpur, UP, committed suicide in Bengaluru. He video-called his wife while hanging himself. His wife panicked and informed his family. His mother immediately called his friends in Bengaluru, asking them to go to his room and save him. By the time people broke down the door and entered, the young man had already died. Upon hearing the news of her husband's death, his wife drank toilet cleaner (acid). She was 4 months pregnant. Due to her serious condition, she has been referred to Kanpur Hallet Hospital. The couple had a love marriage in Delhi 2 years ago. The incident occurred on Tuesday at 2 AM in Rath town, 60 km from the district headquarters. Police stated that the young man's name is Rohit, and his wife's name is Nandini. Made a video call after chatting with his wife Rohit Verma (32), a resident of Farsauliana locality in Rath, worked at a clothing shop in Bengaluru. Rohit had a love marriage with Nandini, a resident of Delhi, two years ago. About two months ago, Rohit's father Virendra Verma passed away. Rohit and Nandini had come to Rath to attend the funeral. After staying for a few days, Rohit returned to Bengaluru for work, while Nandini, being 4 months pregnant, stayed with her mother-in-law in Rath. According to the family, Rohit and Nandini had been fighting for the past three-four days. Both were fighting with each other over the phone. The dispute between the wife and husband had escalated to such an extent that Rohit had saved his wife's number as "Naagin" (Cobra). On Monday too, they had a fight. Late at night, Rohit sent many messages to his wife on WhatsApp. After this, Rohit made a video call to Nandini. He said - I am going to die. Two videos related to Rohit's suicide have also surfaced. When the family started blaming her, the wife drank acid As soon as Rohit's suicide was discovered, there was an uproar in the family. Everyone started scolding Nandini, so Nandini went to her room. There she drank acid. Due to her pregnancy, her condition deteriorated. She was first referred to Orai and then to Kanpur. There, she has been admitted to the ICU at Hallett Hospital. Family left for Bengaluru Rohit's uncle and other relatives have left for Bengaluru. The body will be brought to Rath, where the last rites will be performed. Rath Kotwali Station House Officer Anoop Singh said that information about the entire incident is being gathered. Bengaluru police are also being contacted for confirmation. Further action will be taken only after investigation.

stories.title: Relief for 300 property owners in Dharamshala Market:SDM Sadar orders status quo; probe into entire matter ordered
stories.summary: Three hundred people who have been living in houses built in the Dharamshala Bazaar area of Gorakhpur city have received relief. The land on which their houses are built has been transferred to someone else's name through inheritance. Following this, the citizens protested. When the matter went to the SDM Sadar, it was ordered to maintain the status quo. A decision will be made only after a thorough investigation of the matter. Both parties involved in this dispute reached SDM Sadar Gyan Pratap Singh on Monday and presented their case. This dispute is related to 5.242 hectares of land in Dharamshala Bazaar. On this, inheritance was registered by the order of the Naib Tehsildar. After hearing both parties, the SDM stated that the matter is pending in the revenue court. In such a situation, all parties must maintain the status quo until the final order comes from the court. The court will resolve this matter on the basis of evidence and revenue records. People had protested on Sunday As soon as the residents of the Dharamshala area came to know about the inheritance order, they protested. After which people were called to Sadar Tehsil. A delegation of affected people informed the SDM Sadar that the land on which the then Naib Tehsildar Neeru Singh had issued the inheritance order was outside her jurisdiction. People allege that hundreds of people have been living on this land for a long time by building houses. This order could affect the interests of a large number of people. The Naib Tehsildar who issued this order has been transferred to another tehsil. She states that the order issued was according to rules. She says that the land was not shown as disputed in the file provided. The decision was taken only after receiving a report from the concerned Lekhpal. Based on that, the order of inheritance was issued. SDM said it is a matter for the court SDM Sadar Gyan Pratap Singh said that this matter is in court and the court will decide based on facts and evidence. Both parties have presented their arguments. He said that until a decision is reached in this matter, neither party will be able to change the status quo. Both parties have agreed to this.

stories.title: Cancer patient jumps to death at hospital:Had come from Bihar for treatment; police begin probe
stories.summary: A cancer patient died by suicide by jumping from the fourth floor of Mahamana Madan Mohan Malaviya Cancer Institute in the Chitaipur police station area of Varanasi, in the wee hours of Tuesday. The incident caused a stir in the hospital premises. Upon receiving information, the police and forensic team reached the spot, inspected the crime scene, and collected evidence. Police took possession of the body and placed it in the mortuary for post-mortem proceedings. The deceased was identified as Rameshwar Kumar (35), son of Nandkishore, resident of village Mohajamma, Paru police station, Muzaffarpur district (Bihar). He had been admitted to Mahamana Madan Mohan Malaviya Cancer Institute for several days, undergoing cancer treatment. Family members stated that he was admitted a month ago. Following an operation on Sunday, he was moved to a ward on the fourth floor. Patient jumps in the dead of night On Tuesday morning around 12:50 AM, Rameshwar Kumar reached the fourth floor of IPD Ward No. 4 of the hospital and jumped down from there. Hearing the sound of the fall, there was chaos among the hospital staff and security personnel. People immediately rushed to the spot to see him, but by then, he had already died. Upon receiving information about the incident, Chitaipur police station personnel reached the hospital. The police also called the forensic team to the scene, which thoroughly inspected the crime scene and collected necessary evidence. Subsequently, the body was taken into custody and placed in the morgue for post-mortem. Police investigation underway ACP Bhelupur Gaurav Kumar said, “All aspects of the case are being investigated. Hospital administration, staff on duty, and the deceased's family members are being questioned. Additionally, CCTV camera footage installed in the hospital premises is also being scrutinised to confirm the cause of the incident.”

stories.title: Heavy rain lashes UP:Bikes, scooters submerged in Mathura; 4-ft waterlogging at underpass, roads turn into ponds in Lucknow and Unnao; schools shut in Raebareli
stories.summary: The monsoon has regained momentum across Uttar Pradesh. Intermittent rainfall has been recorded since Tuesday morning in 30 cities, including Lucknow, Kanpur, Prayagraj, Noida, and Mathura, while cloud cover persists over the rest of the state. In Mathura, a heavy downpour led to severe waterlogging, with water levels rising to 4 feet in underpasses. Several motorbikes and scooters were submerged, forcing commuters to wade through waist-deep water. Inundation and Power Outages Lucknow and Unnao have been battered by continuous rainfall for the past 13 hours. The heavy downpours, which began at 9:00 pm on Monday, continued into the morning, turning roads into waterlogged streams and flooding several homes. Power supply was also snapped across multiple localities. Owing to the severe weather, authorities in Raebareli have ordered the closure of all schools up to Class 8. Disruptions Across Districts Agra has also experienced intermittent rainfall since 1:00 am, prompting private schools in the district to declare a holiday. Barabanki witnessed two hours of torrential rain, leaving the central bus station completely flooded. Amethi recorded its first spell of rainfall after a dry spell lasting nearly a week. IMD Weather Forecast The India Meteorological Department (IMD) has issued a rain alert for all 75 districts of the state, with 72 districts warned of potentially heavy rainfall. Heavy downpours are expected over the next two hours in Ayodhya, Amethi, Barabanki, Lucknow, Pratapgarh, Raebareli, Sultanpur, and Unnao. Meanwhile, persistent rainfall in the hilly regions has pushed 10 rivers across Uttar Pradesh, including the Ganges, Ghaghara, and Sharda, into spate. Six villages in Bijnor have been inundated, with boats now plying through the streets. Floodwaters from the Ganges have been flowing over the state highway for the past five days. In Chandpur, a section of the highway has been washed away, leaving a 12-foot-deep crater. Lucknow meteorologist Atul Kumar Singh stated: The monsoon system has now become active over UP. It is passing through Delhi, Lucknow, and Patna, triggering several cyclonic circulations. Monsoon winds have strengthened over the Gangetic plains. Under its impact, heavy downpours are expected across the entire state over the next four to five days.

stories.title: Three-storey furniture showroom catches fire in Kanpur:Smoke visible from 2 km away; over eight fire engines bring blaze under control in four hours
stories.summary: A massive fire broke out at a three-storey furniture showroom in Kanpur at 6:30 am on Tuesday. Within moments, the flames engulfed all floors, throwing up high-rising fire and a dense plume of smoke visible nearly 2 km away. It was initially feared that six people were trapped inside the showroom. Over eight fire engines rushed to the scene, while police closed off traffic completely on the old Govindnagar bridge due to the severity of the situation. After roughly four hours of rigorous efforts, the fire brigade brought the blaze under control. No casualties were reported in the incident, which occurred within the jurisdiction of the Govindnagar police station. Businessman Estimates Loss at Nearly ₹2 Crore The building belongs to Shyam Lal Kukreja and was leased five years ago by furniture dealer Gaurav Bhasin. Bhasin uses the first and third floors as warehouses, while operating a showroom from the second floor. Bhasin, who has been in business for around 25 years, stated: "The fire broke out at around 5:30 am on Tuesday following a short circuit in a utility pole in front of the showroom. Electrical goods belonging to the landlord, Shyam Lal Kukreja, were stored in the basement, though fortunately, the flames did not reach that level." All three above-ground floors were completely gutted in the blaze, destroying furniture worth approximately ₹2 crore (£185,000). Chief Fire Officer (CFO) Deepak Sharma reported: "The control room received an alert regarding a fire at a furniture showroom in Govind Nagar. Roughly eight fire engines from Fazalganj and Kidwai Nagar were deployed to the scene, along with a specialised water tender. Teams tackled the blaze from three directions and have now successfully brought it under control." Shailesh Chauhan’s office is located directly behind the furniture showroom. "We rushed to the spot as soon as we heard about the fire," he said. "Fortunately, the flames did not reach our premises."

stories.title: From paper leaks to politics:Why parties are wooing Gen Z; Rahul, Yogi, Akhilesh and Mayawati compete for young voters' trust
stories.summary: In UP, Gen-Z is no longer just a first-time voter, but has come to the center of politics. Whether power is formed or broken, to some extent, Gen-Z is also playing a role. Opposition parties, including the BJP, are also understanding this. This is why Rahul Gandhi will have a direct conversation with millions of students in Prayagraj on August 8. Akhilesh Yadav's IT team is viralizing videos of Dimple Yadav's presence and her emotional moments during the students' protest at Jantar Mantar. Mayawati has also handed over the command of election campaigning to the party's young face, Akash Anand. Meanwhile, Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath has asked BJP leaders to interact more and more with Gen-Z, and to tell them about the corruption and irregularities that occurred during the SP rule. Parties are preparing to include youth issues in their manifestos. Now the only question is: who will Gen-Z go with? 1. SP - Akhilesh met 200 influencers, focus on Gen-Z content SP's IT team is continuously sharing videos of Dimple Yadav during the student protest at Jantar Mantar, to create an emotional connection with the youth. According to SP sources, Akhilesh met more than 200 social media influencers at the party office in Lucknow in April. Most of them have a good fan following. The party had also reviewed their social media content before inviting these people. The party had also launched a YouTube channel named Samajwadi Party TV last year in August. Where now the focus is on content related to Gen-Z. This channel is run by party spokesperson Naved Siddiqui. He was formerly a radio jockey. On August 2, in a press conference in Lucknow, Akhilesh Yadav had said - SP has many members from Gen-Z and Gen-Alpha. The new generation wants to express themselves without hesitation. The Samajwadi Party is ready to listen to their hopes and problems. He also advised senior party leaders to learn how to make reels and stay connected with Gen-Z. According to senior journalist Siddharth Kalahans, SP appears to be at the forefront in engaging Gen-Z. After the movements, there is visible anger among the youth against the government and a desire for change, which could benefit the opposition. Akhilesh Yadav has been directly reaching out to the youth through digital media since 2024. SP has 2 faces of Gen-Z SP has 2 MPs under 29 years of age, who fall into the Gen-Z category. These include Pushpendra Saroj from Kaushambi and Priya Saroj from Machhlishahr. Both had also reached the students' protest at Jantar Mantar. Now SP is presenting them as the party's Gen-Z face among the youth. Both of them are constantly seen with Dimple Yadav these days. The party's IT cell is also heavily promoting their videos on social media. 2. BSP - Responsibility to youth in booth committees In the protests against paper leaks, Mayawati had also supported youth issues on social media. BSP is also increasing its presence on digital platforms. In booth committees too, emphasis is being laid on giving responsibility to first-time voters and youth along with old leaders. Under this strategy, BSP chief Mayawati has given the responsibility of Mission-2027 to her 31-year-old nephew Akash Anand. Akash is close to the age of Gen-Z. That's why the party feels that he will understand their problems better. Akash will start election rallies from Hathras on August 10. During this, he can raise issues related to youth such as paper leaks, irregularities in government recruitment, and lack of employment. BSP does not have Gen-Z MLAs-MPs BSP has only one MLA, Umashankar Singh, in the assembly. He is over 50 years old. The party currently does not have any Lok Sabha MP. The BSP chief is now taking decisions to connect Gen-Z with her party. Senior journalist Ratanmani Lal believes that Akash's speaking style and ability to connect with youth can attract Gen-Z. Mayawati also communicates through social media instead of press conferences. Now, the party is preparing to increase its reach among youth through videos, visuals, and digital campaigns based on Mayawati's social media messages. 3. Congress - Rahul will visit areas in UP with the highest student population If we combine youth aged 18-30 and 18-40 in UP, this figure exceeds 40%. Congress believes that if these young people unite on issues of employment, education, and their future, rising above caste and religion, the political equation of UP could change. Keeping this in mind, Rahul Gandhi will interact with students and youth at KP Ground in Prayagraj on August 8. Rahul chose Prayagraj because it is home to students preparing for various government jobs, including UPPSC and police recruitment. Students from Prayagraj caused the most uproar in the protests over the NEET paper leak in UP. The Congress wants to convert this anger into its support. Party spokesperson Surendra Singh Rajput says, 'For Congress, issues like paper leaks, unemployment, and expensive education are not just politics, but social issues related to the youth.' After Kota and Dehradun, Rahul Gandhi will now interact with students in Prayagraj. The party is trying to build a digital connection with Gen-Z by continuously sharing students' problems and movements on social media. Gen-Z Representation Zero in Congress In UP, Congress also has zero Gen-Z representation in Parliament or the Assembly. The party is bringing forward young faces through its student organization NSUI and Youth Congress to connect with first-time voters. Rahul Gandhi is also constantly trying to connect with the youth in their style. He also shares these videos on social media. 4. BJP - Party teaching lakhs of workers Instagram-Twitter After the resignation of Union Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan, the BJP is engaged in damage control among the youth. Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath is sending a message of strict action against paper leak and cheating mafia. At the same time, the party is working on a strategy to maintain the trust of Gen-Z before the 2027 assembly elections. In a meeting held at Lok Bhawan on August 2, CM Yogi advised BJP MLAs, MPs, and leaders of allied parties to regularly interact with new voters aged 18 to 25. He said, 'Uttar Pradesh's Gen-Z is not familiar with the tenure of the SP government before 2017. Inform such youth about the law and order situation of that era through social media, colleges, universities, and schools. Earlier, in a rally in Fatehpur on July 25, Yogi had said that 'jail or hell' is the only place for the cheating mafia who toy with the future of the youth. Meanwhile, BJP MLA Dr. Rajeshwar Singh has proposed forming a 'Youth Advisory Committee' to directly convey the grievances of the youth to the government. BJP spokesperson Avnish Tyagi says that Gen-Z from rural and small towns gives more importance to nationalism and development. The party is directly communicating with the youth through PM Modi. The opposition is only inciting the youth and playing caste politics. BJP is teaching Instagram and Twitter to its millions of workers. Certificates are also being given upon becoming digitally trained. Mohan Bhagwat will answer Gen-Z's questions The Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS) has also sensed the changing atmosphere. RSS chief Mohan Bhagwat will interact with Gen-Z in Mumbai on August 6. More than 2,000 students from 100 cities will participate at the Nita Mukesh Ambani Cultural Centre in Bandra-Kurla Complex. It is believed that through this interaction, the Sangh will try to understand the thoughts, hopes, and challenges of the new generation, as well as connect with them.

stories.title: ₹2 crore tent, ₹10 lakh fireworks for Rahul:Student outreach in Prayagraj to launch 'Mission UP'; 3 lakh students invited
stories.summary: The student movement at Jantar Mantar in Delhi has sparked a new debate across the entire country. Rahul Gandhi is preparing to gauge the pulse of students from Prayagraj, known as an education hub. This is aimed at bringing youth as a Congress wave in the assembly elections. Preparations are underway for Rahul Gandhi's much-awaited 'Student Dialogue' program in Prayagraj. On 8th August, Rahul Gandhi will directly interact with approximately 3 lakh students at KP College ground. The special feature of this program is that it will begin at 5 PM. Arrangements for tea and refreshments have been made for all students. Dinner arrangements have also been made for some. Students will also be provided with free e-rickshaw facilities. A tent costing ₹2 crore is being prepared for Rahul Gandhi. There will be fireworks worth ₹10 lakh at Rahul's entry. The catering responsibility has also been given to a Delhi-based company. A corridor is being built in the pandal for Rahul Gandhi. This will be the main center for dialogue between Rahul and the students. Rahul Gandhi shared this information by posting on the social media platform X on Monday. He released the poster of Chhatro Ki Goonj (Students' Echo), which also contains a barcode to register for the student dialogue program. Know what is written in the poster? The caption on the poster reads: If there are no jobs, the throne will shake. After Kota, after Dehradun, now 'Chhatro Ki Goonj' is reaching Prayagraj. This is the city where lakhs of youth have been preparing for years - filling forms, paying fees, and waiting. Paper leaks have stolen their today, stalled recruitments have blocked their tomorrow. And just a few days ago, these very children were subjected to lathi-charge and pellets in Delhi. Simply because they spoke up for their rights. We will continue to raise their voice and ensure they get justice. No more excuses; take accountability or resign from your position. See you in Prayagraj on 8th August. 1.60 lakh students registered so far Online and offline registration is being conducted for Rahul Gandhi's student dialogue. So far, 1.60 lakh students have registered. This process is still ongoing. It is estimated that 3 lakh students will be present to directly interact with Rahul. Registration is also being done through QR code and missed call. ID cards are also being issued to students who register. Free e-rickshaw facility for students The Congress Committee has also arranged e-rickshaws for students coming to the student dialogue. These e-rickshaws will transport students to and from the event venue, so that students don't have to walk. These rickshaws will operate on routes covering the railway station, bus stands, as well as hostels, lodges in the city, and routes to Allahabad University. They will go to student residential areas like Colonelganj, Katra, Salori, Chhota Baghara, Bada Baghara, Shivkuti, Teliyarganj, Sadar Bazaar and other areas. Students can use them by showing their ID cards. Food and beverage arrangements for students A feast has been arranged for Congress leaders and some selected students at the student dialogue. As there will be a large crowd, water and tea arrangements have been made for all students. All students attending the student dialogue will be given the student dialogue book and materials related to Congress policies. Preparation for fireworks worth ₹10 lakhs Rahul Gandhi's student dialogue is being made quite high-tech this time. According to Congressmen, there are preparations for fireworks during Rahul Gandhi's entry at the student dialogue. Rahul will make his entry with a colorful spectacle in the sky. Around ₹10 lakh is being spent on the fireworks. This is being done to present Rahul in a new look. This is why Rahul Gandhi will arrive at the student dialogue at 7 PM. Students will start getting entry from 5 PM. Invitations sent to students from 15 cities Although students from any district of Uttar Pradesh can participate in the student dialogue, Congress has specially sent invitations to students from 15 cities. Along with Prayagraj, students from Kaushambi, Pratapgarh, Sultanpur, Amethi, Raebareli, Jaunpur, Fatehpur, Vindhyachal, Mirzapur, Varanasi, Bhadohi, Faizabad, Kanpur, Azamgarh, Mau and other cities are being prominently included in the student dialogue. Delhi and Maharashtra companies overseeing event A Delhi-based event company is handling everything from registration to seating arrangements for the student dialogue. This company has been hired by the Congress. Additionally, Maharashtra's security agency SAKA has been given charge of security arrangements. Both these companies have been assigned work worth several crores. Only Rahul on stage, ban on sloganeering The main objective of the student dialogue is to engage in conversation with students on serious issues. In this context, guidelines are being issued to students. Many different things are being done apart from politics. UP Congress State In-charge Rajendra Pal Gautam told party workers - We will fight this battle under the leadership of our leader Rahul Gandhi. We are ready to make every kind of sacrifice. I want to tell all colleagues that the 'Chhatro Ki Goonj' program should be completely a students' program. There should be no political sloganeering in it, because Rahul Gandhi is coming to directly interact with students. The registration work should be expedited. This Allahabad is the same land where Rahul Gandhi's family dedicated Anand Bhavan to the nation. Today, the people of the country will begin to respond to injustice from Allahabad. There should be such a large participation of students that day that there is no space left even to place one's feet. Only students should be visible in the program. Rahul Gandhi is coming to listen to, understand, and discuss solutions for the students' pain. Our objective is not just to know the problems, but to resolve them. This mission of Rahul Gandhi will be on issues like unemployment, paper leaks, snatching students' freedom of speech, lathi-charge on students, sending them to jail, registering cases against them, etc. Rahul is preparing to enter the UP elections by reaching the hearts of students. Senior leaders are coming to see the preparations and infuse enthusiasm Rahul Gandhi's program is being considered a bugle before the elections in UP. In such a situation, everyone's eyes are on its preparations. The entire program is being overseen by the central team, but senior leaders are arriving to inspect the preparations. To review the preparations, State President Ajay Rai, State In-charge Rajendra Pal Gautam, National Secretary Rajesh Tiwari, Observer Baijuji, and Congress National Secretary Manoj Tyagi have already made several rounds of Prayagraj. Long tussle over the ground A special team from Delhi Congress has been camping in Prayagraj for 10 days to give the program a historic and grand form. Deliberations were held at two major grounds in the city. First, KP College and Parade Ground were selected. Then, due to security and other reasons, KP College was finalized. The Congress District Committee first obtained permission for KP College Ground from the KP Trust authorities. After that, all documents were submitted, and permission for the student dialogue was obtained from the district administration. The DM has granted permission for the student dialogue. There are preparations to invite Chief Ministers from Congress-ruled states to the program. Along with this, state presidents from all states will also be present. Members of the Congress Central Committee and senior leaders will also be included. State spokesperson and coordinator of Rahul Gandhi's student dialogue, Mo. Farhan, said that permission from the administration has been received. Security arrangements will be robust. Students from all districts of the state are registering. This dialogue by Rahul Gandhi is going to be historic. This will change the image of Congress in the state. It may be noted that Rahul Gandhi started the series of direct dialogues with youth on 17 June from Kota, Rajasthan. This mission was highly appreciated in Kota and Dehradun.

stories.title: 'I raised my brother like mother, nine boys killed him':Girl says, 'I made the Rakhi with my own hands'; someone bring my brother back
stories.summary: '7 years ago, after my mother's death, the three siblings started living and studying at different relatives' homes. Papa went to Hyderabad for work. We used to meet during festivals. All three siblings would celebrate festivals together with Papa at home. Rakshabandhan festival was coming. This time I had made rakhis by hand for both my brothers, Saras and Shiv Narayan. But, on Saturday at 8 pm, miscreants snatched my brother Saras away from me forever. Now I will never be able to meet him.' These words were spoken tearfully by Saras Singh's elder sister Juhi (17) in Gorakhpur. Juhi said, 9-year-old Saras was the youngest. He used to talk about studying and becoming a big officer. He was always eager to get a rakhi tied. I used to tease him a lot. We all used to celebrate festivals together with laughter and fun. Someone, please bring my brother back. Saras's last rites were performed on Sunday (2nd August) evening at his ancestral residence in Araji Tola. Father Arvind Singh, who does paint-polish work in Hyderabad, performed the last rites. The family members have been inconsolable, crying since this incident. The villagers are also angry about the child's murder. Saras used to live and study at his maternal uncle's house Saras Singh was a resident of Madhopur village in Pipraich. His father, Arvind Singh, lives in Hyderabad. Therefore, he had left his children with relatives for their education. Saras was living with his maternal uncle Raju Singh in Madhopur village, Pipraich. He was studying in class 4 at an English medium school in Pipraich. Raju has a paan shop in Bela village. He has 2 sons - Siddharth Singh, Shivkumar (15), and one daughter. 9 boys had beaten him to death On Saturday around 8 PM, Saras was going to his maternal uncle's shop with his cousin brother Shivkumar after having dinner at home. As soon as Saras reached about 500 meters away from home, 9 boys who were lying in ambush surrounded him. After that, they started beating him with sticks and stones. When they tried to go to the police station, the boys attacked again During this, Saras was hit on the head with sticks, and he fell down there, drenched in blood. His brother Shivkumar was also injured. He got wounds on his back from being hit by sharp stones. Family members also reached there upon receiving information. After this, the family members started taking Saras and Shivkumar to the police station. Just then, the accused attacked again with sticks and clubs. When people intervened to save them, the accused fled from the spot. Meanwhile, police arrived after being informed by local people. The family members took both children to the CHC, where doctors referred them to Gorakhpur for treatment. During treatment at BRD Medical College, Saras Singh (9) died on Sunday morning. Shivkumar's treatment is ongoing. On Sunday (August 2), based on a complaint by Saras's maternal uncle Raju Singh at Pipraich police station, a murder case was registered against Sikandar Sahni, Hari, Rahul, Sandeep, Vikas, Ratneshwar, Manoj Gupta, Roshan, and Vijay, all residents of Madhopur village. Skull bone broken due to stick and club blows On Monday, police arrested 3 accused and sent them to jail. These include Manoj Gupta, Ratneshwar Sahni, and Sandeep Kumar. Five police teams have been deployed to arrest the absconding accused, who are conducting raids at various places. Saras's postmortem report stated that death occurred due to a head injury. Saras's skull was fractured due to being hit with sticks and clubs. Locks hanging on the houses of the accused The houses of the absconding accused in this incident are locked. Since Saras's death, those people have locked their houses and gone somewhere. All of them have also switched off their mobile phones. The police are finding out about their relatives, where there is a possibility of them going. Young men harassed sister while returning from coaching Saras Singh's cousin brother Siddharth Singh said - My sister was going to coaching for studies. Then some boys harassed her. We lodged a complaint, then a panchayat was held at the police station. A settlement was reached there. But, 4 days ago, my brother Shivkumar went for a morning run, and then he was hit on the leg with a stick. After this, on Saturday, both our brothers were surrounded and beaten, and Saras Singh died. SP North Gyanendra Kumar informed that 3 accused have been arrested in the murder case. 5 police teams have been deployed to catch the absconding accused. All the accused will be caught very soon. Strict action is being taken against them.

stories.title: Why SP took U-turn on donation theft skit in Parliament:Ram Gopal says, 'It was wrong'; did outrage from seers force Akhilesh to back down?
stories.summary: Opposition MPs were protesting in the Parliament premises on July 31 over the Ram Mandir donation theft. Independent MP Pappu Yadav from Bihar's Purnia seat also reached there. He dressed up as a saint wearing saffron clothes and enacted a drama about donation theft. This angered saints and sadhus across the country. They called it an insult to saffron and Sanatan. Apart from Pappu, the most opposition is being faced by SP and Ayodhya MP Awadhesh Prasad. This has shown nervousness in the statements of SP leaders. The question is The drama was done by Pappu Yadav, then why are saints and sadhus angry with SP? We will know in today's UP Explainer... Question-1: What is the controversy over Pappu Yadav's protest in Parliament? Answer: Question-2: What is the atmosphere among UP's saints against Pappu Yadav's drama? Answer: Question-3: If the protest was done by Pappu Yadav, then why are saints and sages angry with SP? Answer: 1. Direct participation of SP MPs in the drama Actually, SP's senior leadership was present during the drama. Everyone was supporting Pappu Yadav. Pappu Yadav held a donation bowl in the role of a priest, and Dimple Yadav, Awadhesh Prasad, Dharmendra Yadav, Ruchi Veera, and Rajiv Rai put money in it. Many other SP MPs were also standing there. 2. Incident of touching Awadhesh Prasad's feet The root of the entire controversy is the incident of Pappu Yadav touching the feet of Ayodhya MP Awadhesh Prasad. Pappu Yadav placed his head at Awadhesh Prasad's feet. During this, Pappu also placed the picture of Ram Lalla that he was holding in his hand at his feet. This directly connected SP with disrespect in the eyes of saints. 3. Prior allegations against Akhilesh Yadav Even before this entire episode, on July 5, Jagadguru Paramhans Acharya, the Peethadhishwar of Ayodhya's Tapasvi Chhavni, had alleged that the theft of offerings happened at the behest of Akhilesh Yadav. This means suspicion regarding SP already existed in a section of the saint community. The Parliament incident further strengthened it. 4. Clash between politics and religious sentiment The saints allege that SP used this issue to corner BJP-Sangh-VHP, which is fine up to that point. However, such a demonstration should not have been done. In Sanatan Dharma, saffron is a symbol of purity. In this drama, the entire saint community has been portrayed as guilty of theft of offerings. Question-4: What is SP's stance on the entire matter now? Answer: Putting together all the information so far, SP's stance is divided. No official party line has emerged. 1. Ramgopal Yadav (National General Secretary, SP) 3 August What happened was wrong. The saints and seers had nothing to do with the theft at the Ram Temple. It was basically a wrong thing. It should not have happened. 2. Rajiv Rai (SP MP, Ghosi) 3 August That was not our program. We were doing a symbolic demonstration with donation boxes. They suddenly came wearing saffron clothes and sat down and started acting. We were also removing them. 3. Pawan Pandey (Former SP MLA, Ayodhya) 2 August In Lucknow, during BJP National President Nitin Navin's road show, Bajrang Bali was made to dance holding a mace in one hand and a BJP flag in the other. Bajrangbali was turned into a dancer. At that time, BJP and Sangh's Hindutva and Sanatan had gone to sleep. Pappu Yadav made a mistake, but what you people did (beating Awdhesh Prasad's effigy with slippers) has insulted the entire PDA community, Dalit community, and 18 lakh residents of Ayodhya. 4. Akhilesh Yadav (National President, SP) wrote on X on August 2 - BJP is desperate; that's why, after the children of the country, now it is getting life-threatening attacks carried out even on MPs. BJP cannot digest the popularity of MP Pappu Yadav. May Pappu Yadav always remain active like this. Overall situation SP appears divided. Some party leaders are distancing themselves from the method of protest. On the other hand, Akhilesh Yadav is seen defending Pappu Yadav by turning this controversy into an anti-BJP weapon. This contradiction is allowing the BJP and its allies to accuse SP of not having a clear stance. This is being seen as a political risk for SP ahead of the 2027 UP elections.

stories.title: Inspector transferred after touching Muslim man's feet in uniform:Clash with Hindu leaders during protest against Pappu Yadav led to police station siege
stories.summary: A police inspector in Uttar Pradesh's Sambhal district was transferred on Thursday after a video showing him touching the feet of a Muslim elder while in uniform sparked controversy. The video surfaced on Wednesday, following which Superintendent of Police (SP) K. K. Bishnoi transferred Inspector Sudhir Panwar from Sambhal Kotwali to Asmoli Police Station. Inspector Mohit Chaudhary has been appointed as the new Station House Officer (SHO) of Sambhal Kotwali. The transfer came days after Hindu organisations staged protests against the inspector following a confrontation during a demonstration against MP Pappu Yadav. Protest against Pappu Yadav led to confrontation Members of the Bajrang Dal, led by district convenor Nitin Sharma, staged a protest at Shankar Inter College junction on Tuesday afternoon. The protest was against remarks made by MP Pappu Yadav in Parliament regarding the alleged theft of donations at the Ram Temple. Inspector Sudhir Panwar reached the protest site, where an argument reportedly broke out between him and the demonstrators. Protesters alleged that the inspector reprimanded them, snatched a banner from the district convenor and pushed workers into a police vehicle. As the situation escalated, Circle Officer (CO) Sambhal Kuldeep Kumar also reached the spot. Police station gherao and Hanuman Chalisa recital Following the confrontation, workers of the Bajrang Dal and the Vishwa Hindu Parishad (VHP) staged a sit-in outside Sambhal Kotwali on Tuesday. The protesters also recited the Hanuman Chalisa and raised slogans against the inspector. A heated exchange took place between the protesters and Inspector Panwar during the demonstration. Video surfaces a day later On Wednesday, a video emerged showing Inspector Panwar, while in uniform, touching the feet of Nawab Bandu, a resident of Mahmood Khan Sarai locality. The video was initially circulated on social media claiming it was from a Chehallum procession. However, officials later clarified that it was recorded during Muharram. After the video surfaced, Hindu organisations demanded disciplinary action against the inspector. Bajrang Dal levels allegations Bajrang Dal district convenor Nitin Sharma criticised the inspector's conduct, saying police officers take an oath not to bow before anyone while in uniform. He alleged that the inspector mistreated Hindu protesters while showing respect to what he described as "jihadis", claiming the incident had demoralised members of the Hindu community. Criticism over transfer posting Nitin Sharma further alleged that while Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath was working to restore religious sites in Sambhal, the inspector was "touching the feet of a criminal-type and political person". He demanded stricter disciplinary action, saying the inspector should have been sent to the police lines instead of being posted as the officer in charge of another police station. VHP district president Ashu Garg, meanwhile, thanked SP K. K. Bishnoi for removing Inspector Panwar from Sambhal Kotwali. stories.title: Maulana's remarks on Kanwar pilgrims spark outrage:BJP MLA files FIR complaint, demands action over 'terrorist' comment
stories.summary: A fresh political controversy has erupted after All India Imam Association president Maulana Sajid Rashidi described Kanwar pilgrims involved in recent incidents of violence as "terrorists". The remarks prompted BJP MLA Nand Kishore Gurjar from Loni in Ghaziabad to file a complaint at Hazratganj police station in Lucknow, seeking the registration of an FIR against Rashidi. BJP MLA demands strict action Gurjar alleged that Rashidi's statement had hurt religious sentiments and demanded that he be booked under the National Security Act (NSA). He also called for the strictest possible legal action against the cleric. The BJP MLA further referred to Rashidi's controversial remarks made during a television debate two years ago, in which he allegedly made objectionable comments about Hindu deities. Gurjar said he had also sought legal action over those remarks at the time. Deputy CM condemns remarks Reacting to the controversy, Uttar Pradesh Deputy Chief Minister Brajesh Pathak criticised Rashidi's statement. Pathak said the language used by the cleric was "deeply unfortunate" and added that people brought up in Indian culture would not make such remarks. What Rashidi said While referring to the recent assault on police personnel by Kanwar pilgrims in Meerut and vandalism involving a school van in Lucknow, Rashidi said those who indulge in violence, consume intoxicants and harass others should not be called devotees of Lord Shiva. According to Rashidi, such individuals should instead be regarded as "terrorists". Muslim leader also condemns statement Rao Musharraf Ali Pundir, Meerut provincial convenor of the Muslim Rashtriya Manch in Deoband, also criticised Rashidi's remarks. He described the statement as shameful and said such comments weaken the country's unity and harmony. Pundir urged the Union and Uttar Pradesh governments to take cognisance of the matter and arrest Rashidi. Meerut incident that sparked the remarks Rashidi's comments came after an incident in Meerut's Daurala area, where a group of Kanwar pilgrims allegedly assaulted police personnel. According to police, the incident occurred after a motorcycle collided with a group of Kanwar pilgrims returning from Haridwar. An argument escalated into a clash, during which police officers who intervened were allegedly attacked. A constable sustained head injuries in the incident. Earlier controversy over remarks on Dimple Yadav Rashidi was already facing criticism over remarks he made about Samajwadi Party MP Dimple Yadav during a television debate. The controversy stemmed from photographs taken after SP chief Akhilesh Yadav and several party MPs visited the Parliament Mosque during the Monsoon Session of Parliament in July 2025. During the debate, Rashidi allegedly made objectionable comments about Dimple Yadav's attire, drawing widespread criticism from political leaders.

stories.title: Ruckus during Governor's Gorakhpur visit:ABVP and police clash at DDU gate over convocation entry; SHO suspended
stories.summary: A huge commotion broke out between ABVP workers and the police during the convocation ceremony of DDU University in Gorakhpur on Thursday afternoon. A scuffle broke out between ABVP's Provincial Organisation Minister Puneet Agarwal and Cantt Police Station In-charge Sanjay Singh. The atmosphere at the spot was tense for some time. On one hand, the convocation ceremony was going on in the university's convocation hall, while on the other hand, a dispute continued between ABVP workers and the police on the road outside the campus. The matter escalated to such an extent that ABVP workers reached the SSP office to file a complaint. A conversation took place between SSP Dr Kaustubh and ABVP workers for about half an hour. After this, Police Station In-charge Sanjay Singh was suspended, and instructions for a departmental inquiry were given. 2 pictures of the scuffle The matter in detail According to information, the ABVP's provincial organising secretary received an invitation to attend the convocation ceremony held at the university. He joined the programme at 11 AM. Meanwhile, his companions also arrived at the main gate to attend this convocation. But they were not allowed entry. Then, provincial organising secretary Puneet Agarwal reached the gate to pick up his companion. Even after this, his companion could not get entry. First, an argument started between Puneet Agarwal and Cantt Police Station in-charge Sanjay Singh. After this, the matter escalated further. Workers who reached DDU gate chanted slogans A short while later, more than 100 ABVP workers reached the DDU gate. After which, ABVP workers started chanting slogans. Puneet Agarwal alleged that during this time, the police assaulted them. After this, the matter escalated further. Everyone came out from there and first went to Cantt Police Station. They protested fiercely there. After that, more than 100 workers marched on foot on the road and reached the SSP office to complain about the matter. There, a discussion took place between SSP Dr Kaustubh and ABVP workers for about half an hour. Then Station House Officer Sanjay Singh was suspended and instructions for a departmental inquiry were given. ABVP accused the police of spoiling the atmosphere ABVP's Provincial Media Head Shivam Pandey accused the Cantt Police Station in-charge and the police of spoiling the atmosphere over this entire incident. He stated that the police have resorted to brutality. Some of our people had received invitations to attend the Governor's programme. Despite this, the police prevented them from going and demonstrated dictatorship. It is also alleged that ABVP's Provincial Organization Secretary Puneet Agarwal had already received an invitation to attend the ceremony. Puneet had gone inside the programme today. Shivam Pandey stated that there were some other people who had received invitations to go inside, but the police did not allow them to go. After this, the matter escalated further. They alleged that the police also laid hands on Puneet Agarwal during the scuffle. SP City said Station In-charge suspended Taking cognisance of the entire matter, SSP Dr Kaustubh held a discussion with ABVP workers for about half an hour. After this, Cantt Police Station In-charge Sanjay Singh was suspended. On this entire matter, SP City Nimish Patil stated, "On August 6, during a VIP programme, information was received about misbehaviour against Cantt Police Station In-charge Sanjay Singh. Subsequently, taking cognisance of the matter, he was immediately suspended, and a departmental inquiry has also been ordered against him. Further action will be taken based on this.

stories.title: Sitapur BJP MLA gets emotional:Doctor daughter weeps as family severs ties with in-law accused of marrying 25 women; demands death penalty
stories.summary: BJP MLA Gyan Tiwari from Sitapur broke his silence on the allegations against Anuj Trivedi, the father of his son-in-law, of defrauding people by marrying 25 women. On Thursday, he came live on Facebook with his daughter, Dr Pragya Tiwari. Gyan Tiwari said, "Today, I am not speaking as an MLA, but as a father for my daughter. I made my daughter an MBBS doctor. I got her married to Prakhar Trivedi, son of Anuj Trivedi. Later, it was revealed that Anuj Trivedi is accused of marrying several women under different names and defrauding them, for which he has also been to jail." “Today, we feel cheated. Injustice has been done to my daughter. If my daughter wishes, I will also file an FIR against Anuj Trivedi. He is certainly an evil person. Such a person should be hanged,” he said. During this, his daughter, Dr Pragya Tiwari, who was sitting with him, became emotional and was seen crying throughout the video. Maharashtra Police arrested Anuj Trivedi from Greater Noida on 24 May 2026. He is accused of marrying 25 women through matrimonial s and swindling crores of rupees. Currently, Anuj Trivedi is imprisoned in a Maharashtra jail. First, know what the MLA said in the video BJP MLA Gyan Tiwari from Sitapur's Sevta assembly constituency came live on Facebook with his daughter Dr. Pragya Tiwari for about 4 minutes on Thursday around 1 PM. The MLA said, “In 2024, I married my daughter Dr. Pragya in Misrikh, Sitapur district. This marriage was with Prakhar, son of Anuj Trivedi. We had taken information from many people. We had also consulted former MP Janardan Mishra ji before arranging this marriage.” “But today we feel that despite being the father of the daughter whom we made an MBBS doctor, educated, and raised so big, we somewhere fell short. We feel cheated,” he said. Will file an FIR against Anuj Trivedi “We have come to know that several cases are registered against Anuj Trivedi under different names. He married several women and swindled money. FIRs have been registered against him in these very cases. He has also been to jail,” he said. “If my daughter wishes, I will also file an FIR against Anuj Trivedi. It is being said that three-four cases have been registered against him for the way he misled, from 2016, 2018, 2020, 2021, and up to 2022.” “He is definitely an evil person. Such a person should not be spared at any cost. He should remain behind bars. If his son is also involved in this matter, he too should go to jail. Strict action should be taken against him as well.” My daughter will now always stay with me The MLA said that my daughter is independent. “I made her an MBBS doctor. She can earn her own living. I will also build a separate house for her,” he said. “I have two sons and my third child is my daughter. But I was deceived. We were not told that Anuj Trivedi works in real estate. His name has been associated with such cases. We thought he had a small family. My daughter is a doctor, she earns her own living, so the family would be good,” he said. "Looking at the family, everything seemed fine, but we couldn't understand what his character and background had been like before. If there had been cases against him in Sitapur, Lucknow, or nearby, or if he had defrauded anyone, perhaps we would have found out." We have no relation with that family “The marriage took place in 2024, and before that, we had no acquaintance with that family. For this reason, I am also telling my daughter that she should file a lawsuit against Anuj Trivedi, stating that she was also deceived.” “I want to say again that such wicked people, who did not respect women, deceived women or wronged them, should face the strictest possible action. This is my demand. He is currently behind bars. Action is being taken against him. As far as I am concerned, I now have nothing to do with that family.” “My daughter is independent. As long as I am alive, she will stay in my house. This is my promise.” Used to defraud through matrimonial s Anuj Trivedi is a resident of Chandrawal village in Misrikh area. Maharashtra Police arrested Anuj Trivedi from Greater Noida on May 24. At that time, he was living under a fake identity as Chandraprakash Trivedi. He is accused of defrauding 25 women of crores of rupees by luring them into marriage through matrimonial s. According to the police, he defrauded women using several names including Ajay Agarwal, Ajay, Santosh Singh, Jaiprakash, and Ramesh Chandra Gupta. The case began on March 4, 2022, when a 75-year-old woman filed a complaint at the Nayanagar police station in Thane district, Maharashtra. The woman alleged that Anuj Trivedi contacted her 45-year-old daughter through a matrimonial published in a newspaper. He married her on March 1, 2019, and defrauded her. Victims reached Chandrawal, demanded property attachment The victims accused Anuj, calling him 'Ravana of UP', alleging that he used to marry women by giving different identities. He used to swindle lakhs of rupees and jewellery from them. Women also allege that Anuj introduced his son, Prakhar Trivedi, by the name 'Aviral'. He also had a role in the fraud cases. He is accused of marrying 25 women under different names and defrauding them. After his arrest, three victim women reached Chandrawal. After gathering information about the accused's properties, they submitted a memorandum to ADM Ayush Chaudhary demanding their confiscation. Anuj Trivedi is accused of marrying women and defrauding them in several states, including Maharashtra and Prayagraj. Many victim women have come forward. Cases are registered against him at different places. This whole matter came into discussion after his arrest in this case. Currently, he is imprisoned in a Maharashtra jail.

stories.title: Rahul says govt orders baton charges, pellet guns over questions:'It fears the country's students, is trying every way to stop me from visiting Prayagraj'
stories.summary: Congress MP Rahul Gandhi has attacked the BJP government after the cancellation of permission for his program in Prayagraj. Rahul's interaction program with students was proposed at KP Ground on August 8. Earlier yesterday, on August 5, the Kayastha Pathshala (KP) Trust wrote a letter to the City Congress Committee, refusing to provide the ground. Rahul Gandhi wrote on X: “No matter how much the government tries, it cannot stop me from raising students' issues. This government uses lathis (batons) when questions are asked and pellet guns when voices are raised. The administration is trying to suppress the students' voices and stop the programme.” First, Rahul Gandhi's key statements 'Students are fighting for their future' After the cancellation of the KP Ground booking, Rahul Gandhi wrote on X: “Students of Allahabad University are fighting for their future against fee hikes and seat reductions. But instead of listening to them, the administration is filing FIRs against them. Instead of finding solutions to the students' problems, punitive action is being taken.” 'Suppressing the voice of youth is the government's policy' Rahul Gandhi, in his post, targeted the central government, writing that suppressing the voice of youth has become the government's policy. He said, "Ask questions, get lathis; protest, get lawsuits; and raise your voice, get pellet guns." According to him, students who express themselves democratically are being treated with repression. 'Attempts are being made to stop my programme' Rahul Gandhi claimed that ever since he decided to come to Prayagraj to listen to the students, the administration has been trying to stop his programme in every possible way. He wrote that this clearly shows that the government is even afraid of the students' voices. 'I am with the students in every situation' Rahul Gandhi wrote at the end of his post that he stands firmly with the students. No matter how hard the government tries, it cannot stop him from raising the voice of the students, he said, adding he will continue to raise students' issues in every situation. Now read what the Trust said Trust President Chaudhary Jitendra Nath Singh stated, "Students of two schools might be affected by Rahul Gandhi's proposed programme. The ground is for outdoor sports. Continuous rain could worsen the condition of the ground. If the ground is damaged, both the time and effort to repair it will increase. Therefore, it has been suggested to schedule the programme after the rains during holidays. “The High Court has ordered that there should be no disruption to students' studies and academic activities. The college principal himself informed me of this. For this reason, the previously issued permission has been revoked. The amount deposited by Congress has been asked to be withdrawn from the office,” Jitendra Nath said. KP Trust has also sent a copy of the letter to the District Magistrate, General Secretary Kayastha Pathshala, Chaudhary Naunihal Singh Academy, and the Accountant. The Accountant has been instructed to promptly return the deposited amount for ground cleaning and levelling via check. Tent being built at KP Ground was at a cost of ₹2 crores A pandal was being built at KP Ground in Prayagraj for Rahul's program at a cost of ₹2 crores. Fireworks worth ₹10 lakhs were planned for Rahul's entry. The catering responsibility for the event has also been given to a Delhi-based company. A corridor was being built in the pandal from where Rahul Gandhi was to interact with students.
